C1785.title: Ethereum-Based DID/VC Platform for Detecting Synthetic Identity Fraud in Tax Scenarios
C1785.summary: A 2025 IEEE paper presents an Ethereum-based decentralized identity management platform that uses DIDs, verifiable credentials, and zero-knowledge proofs to detect synthetic identity fraud in a simulated U.S. tax filing scenario.
